create_CONLL_2003_CONFIG: create a ConllBuilderConfig for CoNLL-2003 with POS, chunk, and NER tags
create_CONLL_2003_ORDERED_FEATURES: create an ordered feature dict mapping tokens, pos, chunks, and ner columns for CoNLL-2003
create_POS_TAGS: create a tuple of standard POS tags used by CoNLL-2003 datasets
create_CHUNK_TAGS: create a tuple of standard chunk tags used by CoNLL-2003 datasets
create_NER_TAGS: create a tuple of standard NER tags used by CoNLL-2002 and CoNLL-2003 datasets
